notes.TWN: GEM（2026 年 9 月）台灣運轉中的電廠合計 54,822 MW；能源署統計 2025 年（民國 114 年）底全國發電裝置容量 69,858 MW（台電 32,662、民營電廠 17,621、自用發電設備 19,576）。差距主要在太陽能：GEM 只收 1 MW 以上的地面型案場（5,093 MW），能源署含屋頂型共 15,474 MW。另外 GEM 把 2,600 MW 的機組列為封存（不算運轉中），小型的汽電共生、燃氣與水力機組也低於 GEM 的收錄門檻。

notesEn.TWN: GEM (September 2026) lists 54,822 MW of operating capacity in Taiwan; the Energy Administration reports 69,858 MW of installed capacity at the end of 2025 (Taipower 32,662, independent producers 17,621, self-generation 19,576). Most of the gap is solar: GEM only covers ground-mounted farms of 1 MW or more (5,093 MW), while the official figure of 15,474 MW includes rooftop systems. GEM also lists 2,600 MW as mothballed (not operating), and small cogeneration, gas and hydro units fall below its thresholds.
